programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. Presented by John Robbie, Great African Mysteries will unlock the secrets of Africa's past by delving into three major mysteries with fascinating interviews and archival footage.

programme.title: The Curse Of Skinwalker Ranch
programme.desc: 'S7/E1 - All Fired Up'. After new tests reveal shocking clues about the ceramic materials that were extracted from the Mesa, the team fires extreme heat above the Triangle, which leads to stunning phenomena appearing in the sky.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: 'S15/E20 - The Top Ten Alien Petroglyphs'. Examining 75 million years of the most credible alien evidence here on Earth, from the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt to the skies over the western desert in the present day.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: 'S15/E15 - Edgar Cayce: The Sleeping Prophet'. In the early 1900s, Edgar claimed to receive visions of both the past and the future while in a trance, he healed the sick, and alleged to have encounters with otherworldly beings.

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn
programme.desc: 'S5/E10 - Only In Detroit'. As owners of Detroit's biggest pawn shop, the Gold family has bought and sold things you can't begin to imagine. Every day brings new danger as they operate in one of America's most troubled cities.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Submarines War Beneath The Waves'. Follow a new perspective on the military, political and domestic issues of the time, whilst revealing human stories and engineering marvels.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S17/E5 - It's A Brew-Tiful Day In Fulerton'. Lisa keeps getting her lockers taken from her and it makes her hopping mad. Kenny goes in for a banjo but comes out with a harmonica. Dusty & Lupe find the locker of her dreams.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S17/E1 - All About Steve'. Bathed in the heat of Moreno Valley, Kenny has difficulty with names, so he calls an audible. Meanwhile, Brandi can't catch a break without some help from above.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S17/E3 - Million Dollar Brandi'. In West Covina, Dusty uses magic to find his treasure. Lisa, determined to make her carpenter father proud, looks for something to refurbish and ends up channeling something else.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: 'S15/E3 - Mystery Of The Lost Civilization'. The discovery of the ancient megalithic site of Karahan Tepe in southern Turkey turns the world of archaeology on its head, displaying astonishing engineering skills.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: 'S15/E4 - The Power Of The Obelisks'. The obelisks of ancient Egypt was perfectly carved from a single granite rock. Ancient Astronaut Theorists suggest they powered a technology that allowed communication with the gods.

programme.title: Storage Wars: New York
programme.desc: 'S2/E18 - It Takes A Queens Village'. Chris and Tad hope to come up big in the neighbourhood of Queens Village, while Mike B hopes to defeat Big Steve in a bidding war.

programme.title: Storage Wars: New York
programme.desc: 'S2/E19 - Bid With A Bang'. The buyers are hoping for luck in Westchester County. Joe P has scored some great antiques here in the past and is looking for more of the same.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: 'S25/E13 - Leggo My Death Star'. Chum hopes for anything but a blue period when he makes a surreal offer on a Salvador Dali lithograph of Pablo Picasso.

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn
programme.desc: 'S3/E5'. Les and Seth battle it out over the business when a difference of opinion explodes into a family feud. Rich sees dollar signs when a customer brings in what's believed to be a secret government spy camera.

programme.title: Weird Or What? With William Shatner
programme.desc: 'S2/E5 - Parallel Worlds'. While hiking in a New York state park, a woman has a terrifying encounter with a mysterious human-shaped shadow she believes is an entity from another world.

programme.title: Weird Or What? With William Shatner
programme.desc: 'S2/E6 - Freaks Of Nature'. On the East Coast of Canada, a small community is devastated by an earth-shattering 'boom' that leaves scientists scratching their heads.

programme.title: The Curse Of Skinwalker Ranch
programme.desc: 'S7/E1 - All Fired Up'. After new tests reveal shocking clues about the ceramic materials that were extracted from the Mesa, the team fires extreme heat above the Triangle, which leads to stunning phenomena appearing in the sky.

programme.title: Jesus: His Life
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Joseph: The Nativity'. A simple craftsman named Joseph faces a personal test of faith in the small town of Nazareth, when his fiancée Mary tells him she is expecting a child, who is the Son of God.

programme.title: Ross Kemp: Shipwreck Treasure Hunter
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - The U-Boat Terror'. Ross completes his specialist SCUBA training under the expert tutelage of dive Supervisor Neil Brock, then heads up to the Royal Navy's historic naval base in the far northerly Orkney Islands.

programme.title: Mystery Places
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. We explore the Cold War's 54 Titan II missile sites, modern Songdo city, and an abandoned airbase in Croatia. We also experience Indian village's bouncer training and China's fiery village.

programme.title: Mystery Places
programme.desc: 'S1/E2'. We visit a luxury survival condo in Kansas, a minefield in Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina, the King Cobra Village in Thailand, the 'fake' pentagon near Shanghai, and the United Nations Headquarters in New York.

programme.title: Alone
programme.desc: 'S13/E7 - Balancing Act'. With survival hinging on preparation, the remaining participants scramble to secure the essentials.

programme.title: Salvage Kings
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Cold War Secrets'. At the site of the former Yugoslavian Consulate, Ted hopes to salvage invaluable secret relics of the Cold War.

programme.title: Great African Mysteries
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. Presented by John Robbie, Great African Mysteries will unlock the secrets of Africa's past by delving into three major mysteries with fascinating interviews and archival footage.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens

programme.title: Ross Kemp: Mafia And Britain
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Colombia'. Going out on a raid with the army, Ross finds out just how prevalent cocaine is in Colombia. He then heads up into the mountains to hear about the Cali Cartel from the son of its founder.

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks

programme.title: Paranormal: Caught On Camera
programme.desc: 'S8/E1 - Highway Hovercrafts In Texas And More!'. A paranormal investigator explores Minnesota's most haunted cemetery. Next up, a young boy in Pennsylvania runs for his mother when he unexpectedly hears a disembodied voice...

programme.desc: 'S8/E2 - Singing Ghost In Arkansas And More!'. Beginning in Birmingham, England, a family is terrified by what they see while visiting a museum. Could it be the ghost who supposedly haunts the property?
